g.title: security
g.text: Part F - Security zoning: Purdue model levels and IEC 62443 zones & conduits (one plant shown; same at P1-P3)

g.title: cluster_cloud
g.text: Level 5 - Cloud zone: Azure Central India [SL-T 2]

g.title: cluster_cell
g.text: Levels 0-2 - Cell / machine zone (per shop floor VLAN) [SL-T 2-3]

g.title: legend
g.text: Rules: no direct traffic L4/L5 -> L0-L2; all flows initiated from lower to higher level;
deny-by-default firewalls at every conduit; machine protection and alarms never depend on the cloud.
